text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We're at Tracen's annual summer<n>camp. I've got
a little plan in the<n>works, so I made sure to clear our
schedule for half the day.
choice_data_list: Hey Tarumae! Wanna go nature watching?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Nature watching? Sure, but I don't<n>really know the
area well enough to<n>show you around...
choice_data_list: I'll be your guide!
I'll be your guide!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
First off, I'll guide her through the<n>forest. We'll
admire the local flora<n>and fauna as we follow a
stream out<n>to the shore. I'll make sure we're<n>being
safe and respectful—and that<n>we have a blast!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
This area has all kinds of plant life,<n>huh? And the air
is fresh and<n>clear—perfect for relaxing after<n>training.
choice_data_list:
Ooh, look over here! Do you know what kind of tree
this is?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh? This one with the little green<n>fruits on it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hang on... Are these persimmons?<n>Before they turn
orange?
choice_data_list: Bingo! You really know your plants.
Bingo! You really know your plants.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's not often I get to see a<n>persimmon tree,
though, so I'm glad<n>you pointed it out! They don't
really<n>grow up in Hokkaido.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I never knew the fruits started coming<n>in this early. I
always picture them<n>with their bright, autumn
orange<n>color... Hehe, I guess they're on the<n>way.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae gazes at the tree with a<n>twinkle of
curiosity in her eyes. The<n>change of environment
seems to<n>have really caught her interest!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
From there, we follow the trail down<n>the stream.
From what I've heard,<n>the area along the water
should be a<n>great spot to find woodland critters<n>and
birds.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the birdcall just now... I bet it was<n>that beautiful
blue bird up there.
choice_data_list: Good spotting! That looks like a flycatcher.
Good spotting! That looks like a flycatcher.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think you're right! I didn't<n>know they lived
down south too...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
We get them up in Hokkaido, but you<n>rarely see
them! Most of the time,<n>you just hear them.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
It's incredible getting to look at one<n>from this close!
Hehe... This is a photo<n>op if I ever saw one!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Trainer, look! There's a bunch<n>of baby birds
jumping out of their<n>nest!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah! Oh no, it looks like one of them<n>can't fly yet.
choice_data_list: I wish there was something we could do...
I wish there was something we could do...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Trainer, we can't—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...You have to be careful with wild<n>plants. Some of
them have irritants or<n>poison, or could be hiding
dangerous<n>bugs.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even if it was safe, you still shouldn't<n>pick flowers.
The best thing you can<n>do to preserve nature is
leave it<n>alone!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry! I shouldn't have done<n>that...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Uh, um, you... We...
choice_data_list:
We've just gotta watch over the little guy and
cheer him on from back here.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Oh. ...Yeah. Yeah, let's!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And so we stand by quietly, watching<n>as the baby
bird struggles. And then...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Peep, peep! Peep!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: It did it! It flew!
choice_data_list: I'm so glad!
I'm so glad!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Same, I'm glad it was okay! Hehe,<n>moments like
this are what make<n>nature watching so special,
huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We head down to the beach. I've got<n>one more
stop planned for our little<n>nature tour...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea there was a cave out<n>here! I've been
running along the<n>coast during training, but I never
noticed.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's pitch black. We should<n>wait for our eyes
to adjust before<n>moving.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Caves get pretty chilly, huh... And the<n>footing's so
uneven!
choice_data_list: Oh, yep, there's a dip ahead, so watch out.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Okay, thanks for the warning! Oh,<n>there's a bend in
the tunnel. Lemme<n>squeeze by...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Wow! The light looks like stars!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The way pinpricks of sunlight sprinkle<n>through and
bounce off the stalactites<n>fills the cavern with a
star-like glitter.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Nature truly is incredible... I can't<n>believe my eyes!
It's like we just<n>stepped into a fantasy world—a
world<n>where magic is real.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I think... I'm starting to love the<n>land down
south too now.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: There are so many beautiful thingsI've never seen before, but it all feelsso close and welcoming... and it justmakes me wanna know more!
choice_data_list: Ooh, then it sounds like my plan was a success!
Ooh, then it sounds like my plan was a success!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Plan?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today's nature tour was a test run<n>for a
Tomakomai PR project I've<n>been cooking up.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Based on what she told me about PR<n>events before,
I decided to brainstorm<n>ideas for purely
Tomakomai-focused<n>activities we could run
ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
And then it hit me—with Tarumae's<n>knowledge, she
could guide nature<n>walks. Guests would be safe in
her<n>hands, and they'd learn a ton about
Tomakomai's natural beauty!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's got great presentation skills, so<n>I just know
it'll be a hit. Just like our<n>coastal nature walk today!
choice_data_list: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate how much you know<n>about hiking. I've
been learning tons!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
(Thinking back... This whole time,<n>Trainer's been so
positive about<n>everything I taught them.)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Let's do it—this nature walk idea of<n>yours. Together,
we can polish it into<n>something amazing!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
And then, we'll need to find locals to<n>continue the
tours going forward too...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Also, we should make a guidebook<n>for visitors!
That way people know<n>what to pack, and what the
dos and<n>don'ts on trail are.
choice_data_list: We've got our work cut out for us!
We've got our work cut out for us!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Hehe, you never stop amazing<n>me, you know
that?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No matter what I say... you take it in<n>stride and put a
positive spin on it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even when I'm totally overthinking<n>things, or if I
don't phrase my<n>thoughts well. You still see the
vision,<n>and show me how to bring it to life. So<n>now—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
When I'm with you, I can be myself. I<n>don't have to
hide my serious, critical<n>personality.
choice_data_list:
Being serious is one of your biggest charms,
Tarumae!

Being serious is one of your biggest charms,
Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Then I'll take my racing andlocal idol activities extra seriously!And you're staying right here to giveme good, critical advice, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Here, now, in this moment... I think<n>we're finally
seeing eye-to-eye. In<n>terms of racing, idol PR...
everything.<n>And I don't want to lose sight of it.
choice_data_list: Yeah. Let's stay here a little longer...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Nope, we've gotta head out! It'll be<n>high tide soon,
and we are NOT risking<n>the cave flooding!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
...And I'm dragged back to reality as<n>she pulls me
out of our magical little<n>cave. Then, together, we
enjoy the<n>shoreline on our return to camp.
